headline: Zcash Developers Propose Phasing Out Older Privacy System to Counter Threats
summary: Zcash developers want to phase out older privacy systems as a precaution against future attacks, citing risks that AI-assisted discoveries could weaken underlying math.
why: Protocol upgrades and security changes in major privacy coins affect network architecture, user adoption, and regulatory compliance standing.

impacts.name: Zcash
impacts.why: Protocol changes directly impact the network's token infrastructure and security.
